refused_full_stage_frames: The four 1920x1080 primary tier frames (big/mega/epic/max) are text-free and value-safe in the centre, but composited over a real celebration at stage size their pillars bury the tier label, the multiplier readout, the BET window, the SPIN button and the hero. Evidence: scratch composite r115_frame_test.png. They are perimeter art for a layout with a clear border, and this stage has HUD in that border.

assets.role: mega tier now has its OWN bloom. R113 had mega and epic sharing one asset at two strengths because the kit of the day had no mega art; this kit does.

REPLACES the R113 max bloom. R113 measured its own bloom taking the max headline from 14.16:1 contrast down to 4.73:1 and recovered it to 8.41:1 by moving and dimming. This asset is purpose-built compact and headline-safe, so the fix stops being a compromise.

Overdrive-active stage perimeter. ONE raster serves BOTH the active and the settle state: the kit also ships 04-overdrive-settle-accent, but measured against 02 its alpha silhouette IoU is 0.9932 and it is the same frame at 64% brightness and 21% saturation. A CSS filter reproduces it exactly, saves 782 KB, and guarantees the two states register perfectly because they are the same pixels.

refused_feature_splash: feature/01-overdrive-entry-splash (2140 KB) is the same shape of problem as the tier frames: a full-stage spiky arch whose pillars land on the HUD. The perimeter pair is the part of this folder that fits a layout with controls in its border.
